palindrome:
A palindrome is a sequence of characters which reads the same backward as forward. Below is an example of a 255-character palindrome:

```
"Able , was I saw Elba. A Toyota. Race fast, safe car. A Santa at NASA. No lemon, no melon. Was it a car or a cat I saw? Never odd or even."
```

Note: This text is a famous palindrome phrase, and it contains punctuation marks that are included in the counting for this problem.
